name: Moped
description: A motor-driven cycle on two or three wheels with an automatic drive that needs no clutching or shifting, and legally a kind of motorcycle. An electric bike that tops the electric bicycle's 750 watts or 28 mph, or has no operable pedals, lands here.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and a power drive system that needs no clutching or shifting (South Dakota Codified Laws §§32-3-1(15), 32-20-1(2))

The statute caps only a combustion engine, at 50 cc, and doesn't define motor-driven cycle, so it sets no power or speed limit for an electric one (South Dakota Codified Laws §§32-3-1(15), 32-20-1(2))
Riders need a valid driver's license or permit, but not the motorcycle test or endorsement
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a DOT motorcycle helmet
Riders must wear eye protection unless it has an adequate windscreen
Exempt from titling and registration unless the owner chooses to license it
Kept to the normally traveled roads or designated areas in municipal, county and state parks and recreation areas
